description: Points the webhook at the platform and rebuilds allowed_updates from deployed handlers (tgcloud webhook sync). Call it after adding or removing a handler. drop_pending=true discards updates Telegram already queued — destructive, requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required confirm: true when drop_pending is true

drop_pending.description: Discard queued updates (--drop-pending, requires confirm: true)

project_dir.description: Absolute path to a tgcloud project directory (contains .tgcloud/)

title: Re-sync the webhook
